tasks.label: Deploy Pages with Node 22
args: set PATH=%LOCALAPPDATA%\node22;%PATH% && node --version && npm.cmd run pages:deploy

tasks.label: Inspect Git before push
args: git status --short && git branch --show-current && git remote -v && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && git diff --stat && git diff --cached --stat

tasks.label: Locate Git executable
args: if exist "C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" (echo C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe) else (echo Git missing from Program Files); if exist "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Git\cmd\git.exe" (echo %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Git\cmd\git.exe) else (echo Git missing from Local Programs)
